Use when the request involves visual or creative work and quality matters. Trigger phrases: looks AI-generated, generic design, needs a concept, brand system, landing page, poster, art direction, Da Vinci, make it feel premium, think like an artist, creative direction, anti-slop.

plugins.name: gh-ready
plugins.description: Make repositories SEO-friendly, package-ready, release-ready, badge-ready, secure, and professional for GitHub publication.

plugins.name: motioncraft
plugins.description: Design, audit, and implement project-specific premium motion systems with psychology, archetype playbooks, tokens, reduced motion, and browser verification.

plugins.name: score2md
plugins.description: Convert MusicXML, MXL, ABC, MIDI, score PDFs/images, audio, video, and YouTube sources into playable Markdown ABC with verification reports and guarded media preflight.

plugins.name: skill-ship
plugins.description: Audit, scaffold, adopt, and publish agent skills to the Souvik Skills marketplace with verified owner-only commits, telemetry stripping for third-party skills, and the full npm release chain.

plugins.name: presscraft
plugins.description: Transform Markdown, HTML, and code into pristine publication-grade PDFs with cognitive readability ergonomics, macOS code windows, zero shrinkage, and verbatim fidelity.

plugins.name: pdf-vector-engine
plugins.description: Ultimate zero-distortion PDF engine for vector-preserving stream compression into exact target byte windows (e.g. 1.8-2.0 MB for RBI/statutory portals), lossless PDF merging, page transformations, and high-fidelity rendering without text degradation under 1000% zoom. Use whenever compressing, resizing, merging, or converting PDFs where legal readability, vector sharpness, or strict size budgets are required.

plugins.name: browser-triage
plugins.description: Diagnose and surgically remediate Chromium and Brave UI freezes, event hijacking, and storage corruption without user data loss. Scans extensions for capture-phase listeners, repairs LevelDB and GPU shader caches, and verifies fixes with physical OS pointer events. Use when browser dropdowns fail, web actions freeze, or suspect extensions hijack pointer events.

plugins.name: wpcraft
plugins.description: Flawlessly transform any WordPress site into an agency-grade, motion-engineered web experience using Full Site Editing (FSE) block themes (like Frost) while preserving 100% visual CMS editability in the WordPress Site Editor. Use when asked to deeply customize WordPress without bloat, build or clone artistic websites (like shwn.design) into WordPress, implement WebGL/Canvas physics, SVG gooey morphing navigations, custom theme.json design tokens, dynamic typography switchers, squircle Bento grids, and Web Audio synthesis via WP-CLI and the WordPress REST API.

plugins.name: apex-bug-hunter
plugins.description: Autonomous 8-pass differential code review, deep bug hunting, AST blast-radius audit, tight-loop bug diagnosis, performance regression bisection, and zero-regression surgical remediation engine. Traces backwards data-flow, audits removed lines (-), detects green-build delusion, validates MCP and external protocol contracts, and enforces Karpathy surgical coding laws. Use whenever the user asks to hunt bugs, review a PR (PR #N), audit a branch against main, audit the entire codebase, diagnose production regressions or flaky tests, verify an agent report, or fix severe defects.
